args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim carriage returns (`\r`) from lines or normalize line endings before splitting and checking for trailing empty lines, so that files with CRLF line endings ending in a blank line do not leave a trailing `"\r"` that causes a 'Malformed row' error.
args.title: Fix malformed row error on CRLF statement files with trailing blank lines

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Statement files with CRLF line endings end up with a trailing `\r` instead of an empty string when split by `\n`, bypassing the trailing line pop check and throwing a 'Malformed row' error.
